text:
The global activities view is temporally disabled.
Use the activities tab of a session to manage its activities.
It will be available in a future version.
template.text:
Activities view is temporally disabled.
This tab is designed to create "template activities" for them later to be copied into tests.
These "template activities" help the creation of multiple test cases similar with small modifications.
It will be available in a future version.

activities.gameplay_activity.storage.des: Enable the collection and download of the interaction data collected during the gameplay activity.

activities.gameplay_activity.restarted.d: Allow participants to restart the gameplay activity after completion, which can be useful for collecting multiple rounds of interaction data or allowing participants to improve their performance.
activities.gameplay_activity.platform.we: The gameplay activity is based on a web game launched in the browser.
URI of the game to run in the activity.
activities.gameplay_activity.platform.de: The gameplay activity is based on a desktop game launched on the user's machine.
Basic xAPI Data Management By Game
Enable the management of basic xAPI data (activity initialized, suspended/resumed, activity terminated) directly by the game.
Depending on the type of tracker the game uses, the activity will provide a specific settings file.
Xasu Tracker along with the Simva Unity plugin
